test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Walking at (4)/(7) of his normal speed, Abhijet is 36 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
solution:
**Given:**

Reduced speed = 4/7 of normal speed

Delay = 36 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Time ∝ 1 ÷ Speed

Difference in time = New time − Original time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original time = t

⇒ New time = t × (7/4)

⇒ Difference = t × (7/4) − t

⇒ Difference = t × (7/4 − 1)

⇒ Difference = t × (3/4)

⇒ t × (3/4) = 36

⇒ t = 36 × 4 ÷ 3

⇒ t = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48.**
